projectDescription: A fast, focused iOS remote control app for Sonos® speakers that works entirely on your local network — no account, no cloud, no tracking.
keyFeatures: Instant volume control with a single large slider
Sound presets that save EQ, Night Sound, and Speech Boost
Full EQ controls: bass, treble, subwoofer, loudness, and Trueplay
Home theater controls: height channel, Speech Boost, Night Sound, TV source, audio-format badge
Live Activity: volume control on the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island
Up to 4 favorite rooms pinned to the bottom tab bar
No account, no sign-up, no analytics, no ads
Works entirely on local Wi-Fi — no cloud round-trips
publicApiSurface: Local Network discovery via Bonjour (mDNS) using _sonos._tcp
Direct subnet probe fallback for speaker discovery
Sonos local control protocol (HTTP on local network port)
Bluetooth advertising scan for offline/new speaker detection
Sonos public image library (media.sonos.com) for speaker photos
